title: dashboard_todays_missions_heading_test.dart: override trackHasChazaraProvider so ActiveTrackCard stops opening a real UserDatabase
rule: TQ-6 (hermetic tests: no real DB/network) / TQ-2 (fresh, controlled container) / Feathers seam lens

evidence.quote:
final db = ref.watch(userDatabaseProvider);
  final count = await db.stageDao.countStagesForTrack(trackId);

why: _buildApp overrides anyActiveTrackHasChazaraProvider (used by DashboardBody's chazara-review gate), but ActiveTrackCard — rendered because the test passes activeTracks: [_track()] — reads a DIFFERENT, similarly-named provider, trackHasChazaraProvider(track.id), which stays unoverridden and falls through to the real userDatabaseProvider. Confirmed by execution: running this file prints drift's own runtime warning 'WARNING (drift): It looks like you've created the database class UserDatabase multiple times... race conditions will occur and might corrupt the database' twice (once per extra testWidgets in the file), with a stack trace tracing straight through ActiveTrackCard.build -> trackHasChazaraProvider -> userDatabase -> UserDatabase(driftDatabase(...)). The 'widget' test is therefore not hermetic: it opens 3 real native Drift databases per run, the chazara-badge branch in ActiveTrackCard is exercised against whatever that ambient real DB happens to return for stageDao.countStagesForTrack(1) rather than the _track() fixture (so this test asserts nothing about, and cannot regress-guard, that branch), and it is measurably slower and flakier than the fake/in-memory pattern (test/helpers/test_database.dart) used elsewhere in the suite.
recommendation: Add `trackHasChazaraProvider(1).overrideWith((ref) => Future.value(false))` (mirroring the existing anyActiveTrackHasChazaraProvider override) to _buildApp's overrides list, or override userDatabaseProvider directly with the shared in-memory test database helper.
acceptance_criteria: trackHasChazaraProvider(1) (or userDatabaseProvider) is overridden in _buildApp's overrides list.

`flutter test test/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_todays_missions_heading_test.dart` produces zero 'WARNING (drift): ... created the database class UserDatabase multiple times' output.
